# How much will overpaying my mortgage save me?

> Free UK mortgage overpayment calculator: interest saved, years cut off the term, overpaying vs saving, the 10% early repayment charge allowance, and the overpayment needed to be mortgage-free by a target date. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
